name: Animista
summary: Browser playground of 662 ready-made CSS animations you tweak and download as CSS code.
description: An on-demand CSS animations library and playground. Pick a ready-made animation, choose the object (box, circle, image, button, text, background gradients …), adjust duration, timing function, steps, delay, iteration count, direction and fill mode, then preview, favorite and generate code with minify and autoprefixer options to copy the class and keyframes or download only what you use.
contains: 662 ready-made CSS animations and effects indexed
editor options: object, duration, timing function, steps, delay, iteration count, direction, fill mode
generate code with minify and autoprefixer
copy class or keyframes; replay and favorite animations
download only the animations you will use
animation names include rotate, slide, bounce, swing, jello, shadow-drop and text-shadow
